user_query: trass gmail and stories with terms international mgm shipbob ca uk au within last 2 months

intent.goal: find emails and stories containing terms related to international MGM and ShipBob across multiple regions

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    COALESCE(g.subject, '') as subject,
    COALESCE(g.sender_name, '') as sender_name,
    COALESCE(g.sender_email, '') as sender_email,
    COALESCE(g.message_content, '') as message_content
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
LEFT JOIN generic_content gc ON u.page_id = gc.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name IN ('gmail', 'stories')
AND datetime(u.created_time) >= datetime('now', '-2 months')
AND (
    -- Search gmail content
    (u.database_name = 'gmail' AND (
        g.subject LIKE '%international%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%international%' OR
        g.subject LIKE '%mgm%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%mgm%' OR
        g.subject LIKE '%shipbob%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%shipbob%' OR
        g.subject LIKE '%ca%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%ca%' OR
        g.subject LIKE '%uk%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%uk%' OR
        g.subject LIKE '%au%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%au%'
    ))
    OR
    -- Search stories content 
    (u.database_name = 'stories' AND (
        gc.title LIKE '%international%' OR gc.metadata LIKE '%international%' OR
        gc.title LIKE '%mgm%' OR gc.metadata LIKE '%mgm%' OR
        gc.title LIKE '%shipbob%' OR gc.metadata LIKE '%shipbob%' OR
        gc.title LIKE '%ca%' OR gc.metadata LIKE '%ca%' OR
        gc.title LIKE '%uk%' OR gc.metadata LIKE '%uk%' OR
        gc.title LIKE '%au%' OR gc.metadata LIKE '%au%'
    ))
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200;

The following information needs to be provided for access:

Customer Name

· Customer Address

· Customer Country of Residence

· Customer Contact Email Address

· Customer Contact Phone Number

·  Companies House Registration Number (optional for non-UK-based merchants) 

· Customer UK VAT Registration Number

· Customer IMPORT UK EORI Number(s)

· Customer Shipping Agent Name (name of the company used to ship goods to the UK)

· Customer Tax Agent Name

· By Volume, the Top Three Countries to Which Customer Third-Party Goods Are Delivered from Storage in the Last 12 Months
